Name: Maple Grove Farm
Author: Zelxopi
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=3]Just like any farm from the base game, the Maple Grove Farm include it's own farmhouse decor and a custom welcome gift that fit the theme!
[/size][/color][/font]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets
[/url]
2. Install and unzip the mod in your mods folder

3. Create a new game and select the map the same way you would any of the base game map!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
[color=#ffff00][b](TBD)[/b][/color]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/5nUlQhi.png[/img]
